collection_methods: unauthenticated configured public Telegram preview pages
public RSS/Atom headline and excerpt feeds; no article-body scraping
limitations: No Telegram global search or private groups
No X, Facebook, YouTube or general news-site collection
Posts are unverified leads; publication date is not necessarily incident date
RSS availability and update frequency vary by publisher; errors are shown per source.
Only public feed headlines and excerpts are collected; full article content is not mirrored.
Articles are unverified source leads; publication time is not incident time.
Multiple articles may describe the same event and are not automatically independent corroboration.
No social-media platform beyond the separately configured public Telegram preview collector is searched.
summary.notice: Public Telegram preview posts and public RSS/Atom headlines/excerpts only. All items are unverified source leads; publication time is not incident time. Repeated coverage is not independent corroboration. This feed excludes analyst notes and incident decisions.
summary.archive_notice: Daily rolling archive merged from scheduled public-source collection runs. Coverage is bounded by public preview/RSS access and collector limits; this is not a complete record of all posts or news.

posts.text: ❗️ TASS News Roundup, November 19: ▪️ Vladimir Putin has concluded his two-day visit to China ▪️ Kiev and Europe will realize that agreeing to compromises is better than facing realities afterwards, Putin said at a press conference following his summit with Donald Trump and Xi Jinping ▪️ There can be no winners in a nuclear war and it must never be unleashed, says a joint declaration by Putin, Xi and Trump after their trilateral meeting ▪️ Donald Trump said he considers the trilateral meeting with Vladimir Putin and Xi Jinping a huge success, NBC correspondent Gabe Gutierrez reported ▪️ Trump has told Putin and Xi about his desire to achieve peace in Ukraine and to work with them on this, his envoy Jared Kushner said ▪️ A prisoner exchange between Russia and Ukraine is in the final stage of coordination, with Moscow hoping it will take place soon, Kremlin Spokesman Dmitry Peskov said ▪️ A package of four documents was adopted alongside the 2026 APEC Leaders’ Shenzhen Outlook, the Kremlin press service reported ▪️ The Ukrainian army has attacked the Crimean Bridge again, Crimea’s head Sergey Aksyonov wrote on the Max social media platform ▪️ Moscow lodged a strong protest with Finland over new restrictions on Russian nationals, the Foreign Ministry said ▪️ The International Bowling Federation (IBF) has lifted all of its previously imposed restrictions in regard to the international participation of athletes from Russia and Belarus, the Russian Bowling Federation announced ▪️ Damage from unrest in France on October 17–18 could exceed €200 million, the insurance industry association France Assureurs said
